# Online Workshop: Version Control

* **January 28, 2027**
* **2 - 3:30 pm ET (11 am - 12:30 pm PT)**
* **Online (Zoom) [Registration Link Coming Soon]**

## Overview

This workshop will get you started with the [_Discovering Temporal Gene Expression Patterns with CoGAPS in Single-Cell Influenza Infection Data_](https://www.opencasestudies.org/) case study, from the Open Case Studies Project. More details coming soon!

## Intended audience

This workshop is intended for biomedical researchers who wish to expand their data science skillset to latent variables analysis across time and plan to work through the [_Discovering Temporal Gene Expression Patterns with CoGAPS in Single-Cell Influenza Infection Data_](https://www.opencasestudies.org/) case study.
